scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.db:prepare: npm run prisma:generate -w backend && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run seed
scripts.reset-db: npx prisma migrate reset --force --skip-generate --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run seed
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w backend & npm run start -w frontend
scripts.desktop:backend:start: npm run prisma:generate:sqlite -w backend && npm run prisma:push:sqlite -w backend && npm run seed:sqlite -w backend && node backend/dist/desktop-index.js
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w backend && npm run desktop:frontend:build && electron-builder -w --x64 --publish never
